thread.title: Apple's stock seesaws back to gains ahead of earnings report - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Apple's stock seesaws back to gains ahead of earnings report - MarketWatch
text:
Shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, +0.34% rose 0.7% in volatile trade Tuesday, as investors prepared for the technology giant's fiscal third-quarter report due out after the close. The stock had climbed as much as 0.6% soon after the open, then swung lower to be down as much as 0.3%, before bouncing to a gain of as much as 1.2% before paring some gains in afternoon trade. Over the past 20 quarters, the stock has gained the day after the earnings report 11 times, with an average gain of 4.8%. The average loss on post-earnings down days has been 4%. The average move in either direction was 4.4%, while the median move was 4.4%. A move up of over 1.8% on Wednesday would push the stock into record territory. The stock has rallied 16% over the past three months, while the Nasdaq Composite COMP, +0.58% has climbed 8.7% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.34% has gained 5.4%.
